newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil prices hold steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil prices hold steady in quiet trade.

text.p: European fuel oil prices held broadly steady in quiet trade on Tuesday, traders said.
High sulphur barge deals were done at $81 and $81.50 fob ARA, down $2 from Monday's close, although a number of traders said offers were artificially high late yesterday.
Bunker demand was reasonable, estimated at 10,000 tonnes by some and up to 20,000 by others. With swaps at $83.00/$83.50 for May some saw a little upside in physical barge prices.
Generally markets were quiet, with much of this week's business disrupted by public holidays in Britain and Ireland on Monday and in much of the rest of Europe on Thursday.
Both low and high sulphur cargo markets were little discussed and nothing was heard traded.
